card.name: Securing needles and connectors firmly
card.fires_on: Words that finish a phrase about fastening something tightly, such as attached, on, screwing or connection, in syringe and needle instructions. It follows words like securely, tightly or firmly.

modes.label: Securely attached
modes.description: The word attached or on after securely, saying a needle or device must be fixed in place.
modes.example: Assure that the needle or NLAD is securely<< attached>> before beginning the injection.

modes.description: Screwing or turning a needle or connector onto a Luer lock or syringe collar.
